item.title: Union workers locked out of BP refinery in Whiting at midnight Thursday morning due to ongoing labor dispute with company
item.description: More than 800 union workers were locked out of the BP refinery in Whiting, Indiana, at midnight Thursday morning after the company and the union could not reach a contract agreement following months of negotiations.
